operations.description:
With the addons request you can get a list of offers for addon services available for a specific rate, room type
            and guest stay details.The channel code will define which rates will be returned based on the access control 
            configuration for related rates.
operations.summary: Get a list of offers for addon services for the specified guest stay details.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] addons [PATH] booking v 0 addons [PARAMS] adults app arrival channel code date departure expand hotel id key plan rate room rooms type [SCHEMA] addon addons breakdown offer plan rate reservation room

operations.summary: Gets the availability and occupancy for a specific hotel and timespan.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] availability [PATH] booking v 0 availability [PARAMS] app expand from hotel id inlinecount key skip to top [SCHEMA] availability daily detail embedded hotel link object response room

operations.description:
With this endpoint you can request a list of blocks for the hotel chain. Currently we only support to optionally
            filter by the group code linked to the block. Additional filters will be available soon.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] blocks blocks async [PATH] booking v 0 blocks [PARAMS] app code codes count details from group hotel id inlinecount key plan rate skip status to top [SCHEMA] cancellation handle object safe token wait

operations.summary: Get total blocks count that match the given filter criteria.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] blocks blocks count async [PATH] booking v 0 blocks count [PARAMS] app code codes count details from group hotel id key plan rate status to [SCHEMA] cancellation count handle object response safe token total wait

operations.description: Read all informationen about a block including the numbers of blocked rooms per room type and business day.
operations.summary: Gets the details for a specific block.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] blocks single block async [PATH] booking v 0 blocks [PARAMS] app block code id key [SCHEMA] cancellation handle object safe token wait

operations.description:
Here you can easily find bookings matching various criteria. The booking you are looking for has to fullfill all the specified criteria
            at the same time. So if you specify a customer name and a channel code you will get all bookings where the firstname or lastname of a guest or a 
            contact contains the specified value and that have been done through the defined channel.
            A booking can consist of multiple reservations, so even if you are looking for a specific reservation which is part of a multi-room booking you will get
            all reservations for this booking returned.
operations.summary: Find bookings matching the given filter criteria.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] bookings bookings [PATH] booking v 0 bookings [PARAMS] app block cancellation channel code codes company customer date email exclude external filter from hotel id inlinecount key labels market name number plan rate reservation room skip statuses sub to top types [SCHEMA] booking item link list object reservation response

operations.description:
Get the count of all bookings matching your criteria. The bookings have to fullfill all the specified criteria
            at the same time. So if you specify a customer name and a channel code you will get the count for all bookings where the firstname or lastname 
            of a guest or a contact contains the specified value and that have been done through the defined channel.
operations.summary: Get total count of bookings matchung the given filter criteria.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] bookings bookings count [PATH] booking v 0 bookings count [PARAMS] app block cancellation channel code codes company customer date email exclude external filter from hotel id key labels market name number plan rate reservation room statuses sub to types [SCHEMA] count response total

operations.description:
A booking groups all reservations done in one single request and can be identified by the confirmation id.
            Guests usually use the confirmation id to check in at the kiosk, on the website or mobile device. In hetras
            all reservations of one booking share the room type, rate plan and number of guests per room.
operations.summary: Load all reservations for one booking by confirmation id.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] bookings booking [PATH] booking v 0 bookings [PARAMS] app confirmation exclude expand id key [SCHEMA] block cancellation company contact customer daily embedded general guarantee info no plan policy rate reservation reservations response room service show

operations.description: With this request you can load one specific reservation done with one booking request.
operations.summary: Load a specific reservation from a booking.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] bookings reservation [PATH] booking v 0 bookings reservations [PARAMS] app confirmation exclude expand id key number reservation [SCHEMA] address block cancellation company contact customer daily embedded general guarantee info link mailing no object plan policy rate reservation response room service show type

operations.description:
With the rates request you can get a list of different daily rates. You will have to at least 
            specify the hotel, the channel code, and a calendar range. The channel code will define which rates will be 
            returned based on the access control configuration for the rates. Additionally rate plan codes may be specified in
            the request in order to limit only those rates of the given plans, if they are not specified, it will return all the public rate plans.
            If requested the caller may specify whether he wants policies or not.
operations.summary: Get a list of daily rates given a hotel Id, a channel code and a date range.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] daily rates daily rates [PATH] booking v 0 daily rates [PARAMS] app channel code codes expand from hotel id inlinecount key plan rate skip to top [SCHEMA] calendar cancellation daily guarantee hotel link no object offer plan policies policy rate rates response room show type types

operations.description:
With the rates request you can get a list of different rate offers per room type. You will have to at least 
            specify the hotel, the arrival and departure date, number of adults per room and the channel code. The channel code
            will define which rates will be returned based on the access control configuration for the rates.
operations.summary: Get a list of room offers for the specified guest stay details.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] rates [PATH] booking v 0 rates [PARAMS] adults app arrival channel code date departure expand group hotel id key plan rate room rooms type [SCHEMA] offer plan rate rates reservation room service

operations.description:
Create a new booking as defined in the requests payload. You can get more information about the payload if you check out the documentation for the reservation request model.
Please also have a look at the Tutorials.
For more details on how the API responds to errors please check our documentation on Error Handling.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] bookings create booking [PATH] booking v 0 bookings [PARAMS] app confirmation id key send [SCHEMA] address company confirmation contact customer guarantee mailing reservation token

operations.description:
By default this API call assigns a random room, which has the proper room type, is not already assigned to another reservation or has any maintenance status set for the stay period of the underlying reservation. If the arrival date for the underlying reservation is the current business day dirty rooms are excluded by default. For reservation arriving on any latter day the room condition is not taken into account.
By specifiying the room selection criteria in the request body you can influence which room will be assigned. See the request model for further details.
For more details on how the API responds to errors please check our documentation on Error Handling.
operations.summary: Assign a room to a reservation.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] bookings room assignment [PATH] booking v 0 bookings reservations assign room [PARAMS] app confirmation id key number reservation [SCHEMA] assign criteria response room

operations.description:
This request will cancel one specific reservation. It will show up in the hetras UI in the Cancellation and NoShow processing screen and it will be up to the hotel staff to either charge or waive the cancellation fee.
For more details on how the API responds to errors please check our documentation on Error Handling.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] bookings cancel reservation [PATH] booking v 0 bookings reservations cancel [PARAMS] app confirmation id key number reservation send [SCHEMA] cancellation response

operations.description:
With this call you can set a reservation to the status inhouse. It allows only single room reservations to be checked in. The reservation must have assigned a vacant and clean room.
For more details on how the API responds to errors please check our documentation on Error Handling.
operations.summary: Performs a check in operation for a reservation.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] bookings check in [PATH] booking v 0 bookings reservations check in [PARAMS] app confirmation id key number reservation [SCHEMA] base check details in response

operations.description: With this call you can set a reservation to the checkout status. It allows only single room reservations to be checked out. For more details on how the API responds to errors please check our documentation on Error Handling.
operations.summary: Performs a check out operation for a reservation.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] bookings check out [PATH] booking v 0 bookings reservations check out [PARAMS] app confirmation id key number reservation [SCHEMA] base response

operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] bookings terminal authorization [PATH] booking v 0 bookings reservations pre authorize [PARAMS] app confirmation id key number reservation [SCHEMA] authorization base request response terminal
